page_text_ocr_zh:
在我们瓢虫王国里，每一种瓢虫都有自己专属的花衣裳，只要根据花衣裳的颜色和花纹，就能分辨出我们属于哪一种瓢虫。不过，现在你还猜不出我是哪一种瓢虫，因为我还是小宝宝，和爸妈长得一点都不像呢！
瓢虫的背部看起来就像舀水的水瓢，因此被称作瓢虫。瓢虫的体长大多不超过一厘米。每一种瓢虫的花衣裳都不同。
我是奇奇。
我是小问。
瓢虫是完全变态发育的昆虫，幼虫的形态和成虫完全不同。
什么时候我才有花衣裳呢？
page_text_en:
In our ladybug kingdom, each kind of ladybug has its own special flower dress. Just by looking at the color and pattern of the dress, we can tell which kind of ladybug we are. But right now, you can't guess which kind I am, because I'm still a baby and don't look like my parents at all!
Ladybugs' backs look like ladles used for scooping water, which is why they are called ladybugs. Ladybugs are usually no more than one centimeter long. Each kind of ladybug has a different flower dress.
I am Qiqi.
I am Xiao Wen.
Ladybugs are insects that undergo complete metamorphosis. The larva's form is completely different from the adult.
When will I get my flower dress?
summary_zh: 本页介绍了瓢虫王国中不同瓢虫的花衣裳特征，并通过角色奇奇和小问的对话，引出幼虫与成虫形态不同的科普知识。

page_text_ocr_zh:
花衣裳可以保护瓢虫
我们瓢虫的花衣裳既漂亮又抢眼，而且它还具有保护身体的功能。最外层硬硬的外壳，就像盔甲一样坚硬，可以保护我们不受伤害。我真想赶快长大，穿上自己的花衣裳。
前翅：就是瓢虫的花衣裳，可以保护身体和后翅。
后翅：就像一层薄膜，可以用来飞翔。
触角：是嗅觉器官，能够闻到气味。
复眼：由许多小眼睛组成，对物体移动的反应十分灵敏。
瓢虫保命三妙招
1 瓢虫的花衣裳颜色鲜艳，具有警示作用，表示自己有毒或不好吃。
2 一旦遇到敌人又无法逃脱时，瓢虫会立刻缩起脚，倒地装死，有时甚至会摔得六脚朝天，以此来欺骗敌人。
3 瓢虫在脚的关节处会流出又苦又臭的黄色液体，让敌人不想吃它。
这么鲜艳，可能有毒，不能吃。
它死了吗？
敌人来了，先装死吧！
好苦哦！不好吃。
把自己变得又苦又臭，就不会被吃掉啦。
page_text_en:
Flower Clothes Can Protect Ladybugs
Our ladybugs' flower clothes are both beautiful and eye-catching, and they also have the function of protecting our bodies. The hard outer shell, like armor, is tough and can protect us from harm. I really want to grow up quickly and wear my own flower clothes.
Elytra: This is the ladybug's flower clothes, which can protect the body and hind wings.
Hind wings: Like a thin membrane, they can be used for flying.
Antennae: These are olfactory organs that can detect smells.
Compound eyes: Made up of many small eyes, they are very sensitive to moving objects.
Ladybug's Three Survival Tricks
1 The ladybug's flower clothes are brightly colored and serve as a warning, indicating that it is poisonous or unpalatable.
2 When encountering an enemy and unable to escape, the ladybug will immediately curl up its legs, play dead, and sometimes even flip over onto its back to deceive the enemy.
3 The ladybug secretes a bitter and smelly yellow liquid from the joints of its legs, making the enemy unwilling to eat it.
So bright, maybe poisonous, can't eat.
Is it dead?
The enemy is coming, let's play dead first!
So bitter! Not tasty.
Make myself bitter and smelly, then I won't be eaten.
summary_zh: 本页介绍了瓢虫花衣裳的保护功能，并通过图解说明了前翅、后翅、触角和复眼的结构与作用，同时以漫画形式展示了瓢虫的三种保命方法：警戒色、装死和释放苦臭液体。

page_text_ocr_zh:
幼虫变身
最近我不再吃东西，开始准备变身。变身前，我先把身上的皮蜕下，露出橙黄色的蛹，在蛹里静静地休息几天。等我钻破蛹壳出来的时候，就会穿上漂亮的花衣裳了。
1 大多数瓢虫的卵是橙黄色的。
2 孵化后的幼虫以蚜虫为食物。
3 当幼虫准备化蛹时，就不再进食了。
4 幼虫蜕去外皮，露出橙黄色的蛹。
5 蛹的颜色变深，表示蛹里的成虫逐渐发育完全。
6 蛹壳裂开，成虫的头先钻出来。
我变得不想吃东西了。
这表示你要长大，准备化蛹啰！
我终于钻出来了！
page_text_en:
Larva Transformation
Recently, I've stopped eating and started preparing for my transformation. Before transforming, I first shed my skin, revealing an orange-yellow pupa, and rest quietly inside for a few days. When I finally break out of the pupal case, I'll wear my beautiful floral outfit.
1 Most ladybug eggs are orange-yellow.
2 After hatching, the larvae feed on aphids.
3 When the larva is ready to pupate, it stops eating.
4 The larva sheds its outer skin, revealing an orange-yellow pupa.
5 The pupa's color darkens, indicating the adult inside is gradually developing fully.
6 The pupal case splits open, and the adult's head emerges first.
I've stopped wanting to eat.
This means you're growing up and getting ready to pupate!
I've finally emerged!
summary_zh: 本页通过图文结合的方式，介绍了瓢虫从幼虫到成虫的蜕变过程，包括卵、幼虫、化蛹、蛹期发育和成虫破蛹而出的六个阶段，并以对话形式展现了幼虫的心理变化。

page_text_ocr_zh:
七星瓢虫的花衣裳
“咦，我的花衣裳怎么是黄色的呢？”原来，我的花衣裳有魔力，刚从蛹里出来的时候是黄色的、湿湿的、软软的，不过，它会慢慢变干、变硬，还会出现斑点，颜色也会渐渐变红，等到完全变身成功后，我就可以飞了。
我的翅膀湿湿的，还不能飞。
1 刚从蛹里钻出来的成虫，翅膀湿湿软软的，前翅的颜色也比较浅。
2 慢慢地，翅膀的颜色越来越红，斑点也越来越明显。
哇——花衣裳变色了，好神奇哦！
3 终于变成颜色鲜艳的成虫了。
4 等瓢虫的翅膀晾干、变硬后，就可以飞了。
现在你知道我属于哪一种瓢虫了吗？请数数我身上的点点，就知道我是几星瓢虫了！
跟我一起飞翔，到处去探险吧！
page_text_en:
The Flower Costume of the Seven-Spot Ladybug
"Huh, why is my flower costume yellow?" Originally, my flower costume has magic. When I first come out of the pupa, it's yellow, wet, and soft. However, it will gradually dry, harden, develop spots, and its color will slowly turn red. Once I've completely transformed, I can fly.
My wings are wet, and I can't fly yet.
1 The newly emerged adult ladybug has wet, soft wings, and the color of its forewings is also relatively pale.
2 Slowly, the color of the wings becomes redder, and the spots become more obvious.
Wow—the flower costume is changing color! How amazing!
3 Finally, it becomes a brightly colored adult.
4 Once the ladybug's wings are dry and hardened, it can fly.
Now do you know which kind of ladybug I am? Count the spots on my body, and you'll know I'm a七星 ladybug!
Come fly with us and explore everywhere!
summary_zh: 本页通过图文并茂的方式，展示了七星瓢虫从蛹中孵化后，其花衣裳（鞘翅）由黄色、湿软逐渐变为红色、坚硬的过程，并以对话形式呈现了瓢虫的内心感受，最后引导读者通过数点点来识别瓢虫种类。

page_text_ocr_zh:
瓢虫吃大餐
我在蛹里面休息了好几天，现在我的肚子好饿好饿，应该可以一次吃下三百只蚜虫吧！蚜虫喜欢一大群躲在植物的茎上吸食汁液，我快去找找看。“哇，我找到了，准备大吃一顿！”
好吃！
好吃！
开始吃大餐了！
蚜虫
蚜虫
每种瓢虫喜欢吃的昆虫种类都不一样。吃蚜虫、介壳虫等小昆虫的瓢虫，被称为肉食性瓢虫。
蚜虫会吸食农作物的汁液，害死农作物。
瓢虫会吃掉对农作物有害的蚜虫，因此农民很喜欢它们。
7/11
page_text_en:
Ladybug's Big Meal
I rested inside the pupa for several days. Now my stomach is so hungry, I should be able to eat three hundred aphids at once! Aphids like to hide in large groups on plant stems, sucking sap. I'll go look for them. "Wow, I found them! Time for a big meal!"
Delicious!
Delicious!
Time to eat!
Aphids
Aphids
Different ladybugs like to eat different kinds of insects. Ladybugs that eat aphids, scale insects, and other small insects are called carnivorous ladybugs.
Aphids suck sap from crops and kill the plants.
Ladybugs eat aphids that are harmful to crops, so farmers like them very much.
7/11
summary_zh: 本页通过图文结合的方式，展示了瓢虫以蚜虫为食的场景，并解释了蚜虫对农作物的危害以及瓢虫作为益虫对农业的积极作用，同时通过对话和插图生动呈现了瓢虫进食的过程。

有些瓢虫也会吃植物，甚至是农作物的叶子。
植食性瓢虫
外表没有光泽，有细绒毛，爱吃的食物有叶子、花和花粉。
花
花粉
叶子
穿绒毛衣裳的瓢虫
“你的花衣裳有绒毛，好酷哦！”我在茄子的叶子上遇到了穿绒毛衣的瓢虫，它身上的斑点真多。不过，它不吃虫，只吃植物的叶子、花和花粉。原来，我们瓢虫王国的世界里，也有不吃虫的瓢虫！
肉食性瓢虫
外表有光泽，没有细绒毛，爱吃的食物有蚜虫、介壳虫、飞虱等。
蚜虫
飞虱
介壳虫
好漂亮的小瓢虫。
你搞错了，我是金花虫，我的触角比较长哦！
金花虫和瓢虫的外形很像，前翅上也有许多不同的颜色和斑点。不过，大多数金花虫是植食性的，而瓢虫大多是肉食性的。
page_text_en:
Some ladybugs also eat plants, even the leaves of crops.
Herbivorous Ladybugs
They have no shine, have fine downy hairs, and eat leaves, flowers, and pollen.
Flower
Pollen
Leaf
Ladybugs in Fuzzy Coats
"Your floral coat has fuzz, so cool!" I met a ladybug in a fuzzy coat on the leaves of eggplant. It has many spots. However, it doesn't eat insects, only plant leaves, flowers, and pollen. It turns out, in our ladybug kingdom, there are also ladybugs that don't eat insects!
Carnivorous Ladybugs
They have a shiny surface, no fine downy hairs, and eat aphids, scale insects, and leafhoppers.
Aphid
Leafhopper
Scale Insect
What a beautiful little ladybug.
You're wrong, I'm a tortoise beetle, and my antennae are longer!
Tortoise beetles and ladybugs look very similar, with many different colors and spots on their forewings. However, most tortoise beetles are herbivorous, while ladybugs are mostly carnivorous.
summary_zh: 本页通过图文对比介绍了植食性瓢虫和肉食性瓢虫的区别，并通过对话形式说明了金花虫与瓢虫的外形相似但习性不同，强调了瓢虫大多为肉食性，而金花虫多为植食性。

page_text_ocr_zh:
瓢虫大集合
我们瓢虫的种类很多，大约有五千种，每一种瓢虫的颜色、斑纹都不同，有红色、黄色和黑色，也有斑点、条纹和锚纹的瓢虫。这么多种类怎么分辨呢？其实很简单，只要看我们穿的衣裳图案就知道了。

六条瓢虫
前翅是红色的，左右各有三条横向的黑斑纹。

黄瓢虫
前翅是黄色的，没有任何斑点或花纹。

二星瓢虫
两只前翅的中间各有一块黑斑。

八仙黑斑瓢虫
前翅有八块黑斑，食物是华八仙的叶片。

锚纹瓢虫
前翅是红色的，黑斑很像船锚的形状。

赤星瓢虫
前翅是黑色的，两边各有一块椭圆形的红斑。

大部分瓢虫是以身上的颜色或斑点来命名的。

我是七星瓢虫，身上有七个斑点。
page_text_en:
Ladybug Collection
There are many types of ladybugs, about five thousand kinds. Each ladybug has different colors and patterns, including red, yellow, and black, with spots, stripes, and anchor patterns. How to distinguish so many types? It's very simple, just look at the patterns on our clothes.

Six-striped Ladybug
The forewings are red, with three horizontal black stripes on each side.

Yellow Ladybug
The forewings are yellow, with no spots or patterns.

Two-spotted Ladybug
Each forewing has one black spot in the middle.

Eight-spotted Black Ladybug
The forewings have eight black spots, and the food is the leaves of the plant 'Hua Baxian'.

Anchor-patterned Ladybug
The forewings are red, and the black spots resemble the shape of an anchor.

Red-star Ladybug
The forewings are black, with one oval red spot on each side.

Most ladybugs are named after their colors or spots.

I am the Seven-spotted Ladybug, with seven spots on my body.
summary_zh: 本页以图文并茂的形式介绍了多种瓢虫，包括六条瓢虫、黄瓢虫、二星瓢虫、八仙黑斑瓢虫、锚纹瓢虫和赤星瓢虫，并通过对话形式说明瓢虫多以颜色或斑点命名。
本页展示了一只七星瓢虫正在绿色植物茎上捕食蚜虫的场景，周围聚集着大量蚜虫，画面聚焦于瓢虫进食的瞬间，体现其作为益虫的捕食行为。
